title: Olubiri lw’endabirwamu
intro: Kuba akafaananyi ng’ensi eri ewala ennyo erimu obugagga n’ekitiibwa omuli enjuba mu kifo ky’Omutonzi waayo. Ebbaluwa etuuka ng’eriko omulanga ogutayinza kubuusibwa maaso, era olugendo ne lutandika nga lwolekera kkooti enkulu okusinga yonna eyalabibwa emabegako. Eyo, okwefuula kujja kubikkulwa wansi alimba amaaso, era akaseera ak’okutegeera obulungi kajja kukyusa buli kimu.
clues: Nafuga ensi ekulaakulana abantu baayo gye bavuunamira enjuba mu kifo kya Allah.
Nafuna ebbaluwa ey’ekitiibwa ng’enkubira essimu si kwegulumiza wabula nzije mugondera Allah.
Nneebuuza ku lukiiko lwange ne nsooka kulonda diplomacy, nga nsindika ekirabo okugezesa oyo asindikidde.
Najja e Sulayman, era entebe yange yennyini n’eyanjulwa nga yeefudde okugezesa okutegeera kwange.
Nayingira mu lubiri oluwanvu nga wansi waalwo ow’endabirwamu omuseeneekerevu nnakikyamudde nti amazzi amawanvu.
Nalangirira okugondera kwange ne Sulayman eri Allah, Mukama w’ensi.

trial.label: Okugezesebwa/Ekibaddewo
options: Emira ekyennyanja ekinene mu buziba bw’ennyanja
Yakubwa emyaka mingi ng’alwadde n’okufiirwa amaka
Alagiddwa okusaddaaka omwana omwagalwa mu kirooto
Yagezesebwa entebe ey’obwakabaka eyeefudde n’olubiri olw’endabirwamu
Basuuliddwa mu muliro ogwaka olw’okumenya ebifaananyi
trial.answer: Yagezesebwa entebe ey’obwakabaka eyeefudde n’olubiri olw’endabirwamu

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Yasigala mu butakkiriza era n’azikirizibwa n’abantu bange
Yagondera ne Sulayman eri Allah, Mukama w’ensi
Babbira mu nnyanja nga bagoberera abakkiriza
outcome.answer: Yagondera ne Sulayman eri Allah, Mukama w’ensi

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
